title: From a dull to a lifted Driveway
beforeAlt: Boring fence featuring messy Lilly Pillies
afterAlt: Elevated Hamptons inspired fence, with a soft native planting.
description: The client's driveway felt small and not open enough for cars and boats to be safely parked. The challenge was to recreate a dull driveway into a practical but also beautiful space that also works as a pool fence. Getting rid of the old Lilly Pillies was crucial, as well as introducing a planting that performs well in sandy soil, exposed to coastal winds. The shade of blues and greens against the white fence and house walls achieves a sense of calm and openness, which was one of the main goals for the big family.
